description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Quartz Eye Mode (Fire, Ice, Lightning)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Matoya], [Matoya's Might Damage Tracker] and [Matoya's Might Level]

description.name: Quartz Eye Mode (Fire, Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire] after using a Fire ability, grants [Attach Ice] after using an Ice ability, grants [Attach Lightning] after using an Lightning ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Matoya
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Matoya's Might (0~2), removed after using Matoya's Might two times

description.name: Matoya's Might Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Matoya's Might level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Matoya]

description.name: Matoya's Might Level
description.text: Keeps track of Matoya's Might level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Matoya]
